analysis.summary: Toss The Coin Limited held its earnings conference call for the half year ended September 30, 2025, reporting a 58% year-on-year revenue growth driven by strong commercial traction, new client additions, and a diversified service mix. Management highlighted key strategic focus areas including expanding presentation services, scaling up business development in India, and exploring inorganic growth opportunities in marketing automation. The company also emphasized maintaining profitability with a minimum EBITDA margin target while scaling operations and strengthening internal systems and ISO-certified data security. Toss The Coin Limited published its investor presentation for June 2025 detailing financial highlights for the fiscal year 2024-25, including operational revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax growth. Management outlined strategic digital innovation initiatives with AI-led products such as Ray, Etch, and Kath.ai.

demand_outlook.claim: B2B procurement has been tending towards being cautious and fragmented, with decision timelines becoming non-linear and involving more stakeholders.
demand_outlook.quote: B2B procurement, specifically technology procurement has been tending towards being cautious and fragmented, decision timelines becoming more non-linear, involving more stakeholders, and necessitating higher justification for every investment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring inorganic growth through the acquisition of a marketing automation technology company.
capex_expansion.quote: We do think that in the next, you know, in the next two quarters, we want to be able to identify and, at least start identifying and doing due diligence for a technology company that is in the space of marketing automation.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported an on-hand revenue visibility of USD 1.16 Million.

risks_headwinds.claim: The top 3 clients contribute approximately 35% of the company's total revenue.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now, to your other question, client concentration, what happens is our top 3 clients are definitely contributing 35% of our revenue.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to identify and start due diligence for a marketing automation technology company in the next two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: We do think that in the next, you know, in the next two quarters, we want to be able to identify and, at least start identifying and doing due diligence for a technology company that is in the space of marketing automation.

management_commitments.claim: The company stated it is currently piloting a service with a close network for user-generated feedback and will build a revenue model around this in the coming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Currently piloting this with close network for user-generated feedback. Will build a revenue model around this in the coming quarter.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
